sources.note: PLACEHOLDER until the enemy has canon. Owner-supplied art: PixelLab character 4a75b4ac-7732-499a-84f4-d3a06937a6c2 'Black ooze with teeth'. LIGHT-SHIFTED derivations, not the raw frames -- the raw body is 94% Demichrome Dark, invisible against the Dark floor in the sprite path (M_Swarm is Unlit+Masked and samples the texture directly, so it has no equivalent of the debug renderer's Swarm.UnitLightFloor). Shifted once (Dark->Steel). r2: the brood has NO rotations, so it stays direction-agnostic -- all 8 direction columns reference this same south pair, and the decode in SwarmSheet still indexes it by direction so the brood upgrades to real facings later without a layout change. attack/hit frames dropped at r2 with the rest of the anim axis.

OWNER-SUPPLIED, replaces the managed 'unit-retinue' militia 2026-07-25 at the owner's direction: PixelLab character 1c935515-0ea3-459b-8c63-e7f8cf368272 'Hallam (Vanguard)', a uniform armoured knight with closed helm, kite shield and spear. Kept as an unmanaged path map because the character was authored in the web Character Creator, so no prompt/anchor of ours reproduces it. Straight quantize, NO light-shift: measured 38% Dark / 37% Steel / 21% Bone / 3% Pale, close to the ideal 4-value spread. r2 (2026-07-26): the eight rotations under raw/rotations/ were sitting UNUSED -- r1 packed south only. They are now the direction axis. south keeps its real walk pair (frame_000/002); the other seven duplicate their idle rotation into both walk columns, so a unit walking south bobs and one walking north is static. That is additive, not a regression (r1 had no facing at all), and it resolves with one 8-direction template walk (~8 generations) that drops straight into the walk1 row with NO layout, decode or Sub UV change.
